$comment: Aether Fight — asset generation manifest. `npm run assets:plan` to preview, `npm run assets:generate` to render with your API keys. Edit prompts freely; add items to expand. Vector starter assets already live alongside this file.
artDirection: cohesive stylized game art for 'Aether Fight'; painterly flat-shaded with dramatic rim lighting; dark indigo base palette (#07080d / #1d2740) with warm gold (#d9b46a) accents; clean silhouettes, readable at small sizes; no text, no watermark, no logos
negative: blurry, low-res, extra limbs, deformed hands, text, watermark, signature, photo, oversaturated

avatars.note: character portraits keyed to Codex styles; best with Gemini 2.5 Flash Image for consistency
